english.title: Keeper of bovine animal fail to arrange post movement testing in low TB area (Wales)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 13A(2) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
keeper of bovine animal
received an animal which was moved into low tuberculosis area in Wales
from a herd located in the intermediate TB area/the high TB area/England/Northern Ireland and
failed to arrange a post-movement test between 60 and 120 days
after the date of arrival at the receiving premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
